changelog.summary: Sign-in now returns the provider's profile: ConnectResult gains an optional `profile` of { name?, email?, picture? }, so apps can greet the user by name instead of by address. It is passed through from the verified Google or KingsChat response and never stored — the backend keeps only an HMAC and a masked identifier — so it is available at sign-in and nowhere else. Absent entirely for email sign-in. Expo SDK 0.2.0 has the same field. useSocialAuth() exposes it as `profile`, null until a sign-in returns one and not restored across reloads.

KingsChat sign-in now requests only the profile scope by default, in both the web and Expo SDKs. It previously asked for send_chat_message, which put 'post as you' on a consent screen whose only job is to log the user in. Pass `scopes` explicitly if your app actually sends chat messages.

React Native / Expo SDK released as decane-connect-kit-expo (see llms-expo.txt). Server-assisted recovery is now always on — a user who reinstalls gets their wallet back from signing in alone, so the serverAssistedRecovery option was removed. Google sign-in on mobile uses an in-app auth sheet needing nothing registered in Google Cloud. Adds connectWithGoogleToken() so native Google Sign-In resolves to the SAME wallet as the web redirect flow, and connectWithKingsChat().

Optional per-signature authority: requireAssertionPerSignature makes every signature need a fresh passkey assertion, verified inside the TEE against a single-use 60s challenge, instead of an unlocked session signing freely until expiry. The session still stays warm — this does NOT shorten sessionDurationMinutes. Available on both DecaneConnectConfig and SocialConfig. Default false, so existing behaviour is unchanged. Requires TEE signer v0.2.3+.

Custom auth: sign in with a JWT from your own issuer (Auth0, Clerk, Firebase, Cognito, or your own backend). Adds DecaneConnect.connectWithToken(token, opts?), SocialConfig.customAuth, and useSocialAuth().signInWithToken / .signInWithCustomAuth. Backward compatible — no existing API changed.
Baseline for this manifest. Wallet connect (EVM, Solana, Tron, Bitcoin) plus non-custodial social sign-in via Google and email, TEE-backed signing, 2-of-3 Shamir recovery.
